description: This file defines the RealtimeUpdatesManager class responsible for managing real-time updates of live match scores via polling. It interacts with a backend API and provides callback functions for updates and status messages.

classes.name: RealtimeUpdatesManager
classes.description: A class that manages real-time updates by polling the backend for live match scores and invoking callbacks with updates or status changes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins real-time updates; currently uses polling every 15 seconds.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the real-time updates polling process.

methods.name: startPolling
methods.description: Sets up a timer to periodically fetch live match data from the backend API.
